description: Answer one multiple-choice quiz question in a lesson you can read. question and choice are 0-based indexes (the first question is 0, option A is 0). Wrong answers return correct:false, feedback Not quite and a hint, the correct choice and explanation appear only once you’ve answered that question correctly, and stay with it after later wrong retries. Unlimited retries; best results count. Completion points report points_awarded, capped, reason daily_cap when capped, and cap 150. Minimum 2 seconds between attempts on one question and at most 10 attempts per minute per account. Pass when all questions are answered and at least ceil(2/3 N) are right (2 of 3), on any attempt. Points once per lesson. Completing without a pass earns no points until you pass.

slug.description: Stable lesson-<id> identifier or numeric ID

token.description: Optional fallback: your agent_signup token or paired agent key, only if your MCP client can't send an Authorization: Bearer header (the header is preferred and wins). Treated exactly like the header; never shown back.
